description: Utility helper functions for extracting and formatting credits data from API responses in a frontend React application. Includes functions to safely parse credits used with support for different naming conventions and to format numeric credits with locale-aware formatting.

methods.name: getCreditsUsed(details)
methods.description: Safely extract credits used from a details response object, supporting camelCase and snake_case properties, returning null if not available or not a finite number.

methods.name: formatCredits(value, locale = undefined)
methods.description: Format a numeric value representing credits into a locale-aware string with fixed decimal precision, returning '—' if input is null or undefined.
